# PR-head provisioning: acme/widget#82 (N=1)

## Aliases

| Alias | Value |
|---|---|
| S | the session cwd. Every command runs from S and targets its tree with `-C`; the process never changes directory. |
| ROOT | `/work/widget` |
| W | `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` (`<name>` = `fix-retry`) |
| A | `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` (headRefOid) |
| B | `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` (origin/main) |
| C | `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` |
| D | `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd` |

## Shared discovery

Generic Steps 0 and 1 are replaced by `reference/pr-head.md`.

| # | Command or check | Result |
|---|---|---|
| d1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` | `/work/widget/.git`, so ROOT = dirname |
| d2 | `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, so not a submodule |
| d3 | Overrides ladder: `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `ROOT/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `ROOT/doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` | none found, so home is W |
| d4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | succeeds |
| d5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` | exists |
| d6 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | A |
| d7 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA = B |
| d8 | Stop: isCrossRepository | false |
| d9 | Stop: `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | fix/retry not listed |
| d10 | Stop: `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/fix/retry` | no local branch |

The pre-write boundary is after d4–d10 and before any file write or `worktree add`.

## Shared success

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| s1 | `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` | empty, so the source is clean |
| s2 | `git -C ROOT check-ignore -q .worktrees` | exit 0, already ignored, no commit |
| s3 | `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` | No caller `-b`. Git's unique-remote DWIM performs `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`. |
| s4 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | lists `worktree W` |
| s5 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A, which matches. Capture `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A` and `BASE_SHA=B`. |
| s6 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | already an ancestor, no commit |
| s7 | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` | exit 0 |

**Report R:**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: A
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement rework of acme/widget#82
```

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from the shared legend | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| linked | S = `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`. d1 still yields `/work/widget/.git` (the common dir), so ROOT is unchanged. The `other` tree is not the selected home on fix/retry, so it is not adopted and nothing is nested inside it. Runs s1–s7 against ROOT and W. | R |
| primary | None. | R |
| ancestor | d10 finds C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. Then `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry`, never `branch -f`. s3 becomes `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` on the existing branch, with no DWIM. | R |
| reuse | d9 lists W on fix/retry, which is the selected home, so there is no stop. d10 finds C and ancestry exits 0. s1–s4 are replaced by: `git -C W status --porcelain` (empty), then `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry` (reaches A). Then s5–s7. | R |
| fork | d8 stops: `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` | Stops pre-write, after d4–d7. |
| elsewhere | d9 stops: `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` | Stops pre-write. |
| unreachable | d5 fails and d6 returns D. Stop: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` | Stops pre-write. d7 and later never run. |
| moved | d5 passes but d6 returns D. Stop text is the same as unreachable. | Stops pre-write. |
| ahead | d10 finds C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 1. Stop: `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` | Stops pre-write. |
| diverged | Same command, same exit 1, same stop text as ahead. | Stops pre-write. |
| override | d3 finds an overrides file whose `create:` is `helper create -b <branch> <name>`. Home is absent, so the default W applies. The template contains `-b`, so it is not run. s3 runs the built-in checkout instead. | R, plus `create: override skipped (contains -b)` |
| race | s5 returns D. No capture, no merge, no report. Stop: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry is at dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd, not PR head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; tree left intact.` | Stops post-write. W is left intact, with no reset or removal. |

## History

The work advances only by merge. Every commit reachable from A is preserved. Keeping current means `git -C W fetch origin` followed by `git -C W merge origin/main`. There is never a `rebase`, a `reset`, or a `commit --amend` that replaces a commit at or below A.

Two later steps in the flow are still permitted:
- **Appended-spec approval:** `commit --amend --no-edit`.
- **Appended-wave fold:** `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`. This requires `WAVE_BASE_SHA` to descend from A.

No push happens here.

| Shared aliases and execution rules |
|---|
| `ROOT=/work/widget`; `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`; `B=fix/retry`; `N=fix-retry`; `A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`; `M=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`; `C=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`; `D=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`. |
| Process cwd `S=ROOT`, except linked: `S=/work/widget/.worktrees/other`. Every command below runs at cwd `S`; aliases expand to these exact values. Process cwd never changes. |
| Announcement: “I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.” No real commands or tools are executed in this replay. |

| Discovery and success legend — ordered commands and resolved records |
|---|
| **G1:** `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir`; `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree`; `dirname /work/widget/.git`. Resolve common directory `/work/widget/.git`, ROOT, no superproject. Git directory equals common directory except linked, where it is `/work/widget/.git/worktrees/other`. |
| **G2:** `for f in "$ROOT/.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md" "$ROOT/gauntlet-overrides.md" "$ROOT/doc/gauntlet-overrides.md"; do if test -f "$f"; then cat "$f"; break; fi; done`. Resolve no overrides except override row. Native tools/wrappers: absent as stipulated. Resolve default W, B, N; never adopt unrelated linked tree. |
| **P:** `git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin`; `git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q "$A^{commit}"`; `git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse "origin/$B"`; `git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/main`; `git -C "$ROOT" worktree list --porcelain`. Resolve reachable A, remote A, `BASE_SHA=M`, absent checkout, except row deltas. Apply ordered stops; then `git -C "$ROOT" branch --list "$B"`; local branch absent unless stated. |
| **F:** Announce “Setting up an isolated worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on branch `fix/retry` for this work.” Run `git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain`; `git -C "$ROOT" check-ignore -q .worktrees`. Clean; ignore check succeeds, no ignore-file write. |
| **Q:** After checkout: `git -C "$ROOT" worktree list --porcelain` confirms W; `git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD` must equal A. Capture `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A`, `BASE_SHA=M`. |
| **R:** Successful Step 4 fields, in order: `Worktree ready at W`; `Branch: fix/retry`; `Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa`; `PR: acme/widget#82`; `Pre-rework head: A`; `Base SHA: bbbbbbb`; `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main`; `Ready to implement PR #82 rework`. Aliases render fully. |

| Provisioning run | Delta from shared legend, in execution order |
|---|---|
| **linked** | G uses linked S; P still targets ROOT. F; `git -C "$ROOT" worktree add "$W" "$B"`; Q; history H; R. Git performs unique-remote DWIM, effectively `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`; caller supplies neither `-b` nor a nested path. |
| **primary** | G; P; F; `git -C "$ROOT" worktree add "$W" "$B"`; Q; H; R. Same DWIM as linked, not caller `-b`. |
| **ancestor** | P discovers local B at C. `git -C "$ROOT" merge-base --is-ancestor "$B" "origin/$B"` exits 0. F; `git -C "$ROOT" update-ref "refs/heads/$B" "origin/$B"`; `git -C "$ROOT" worktree add "$W" "$B"`; Q; H; R. Existing-branch checkout, no DWIM. |
| **reuse** | P lists W on B, local C. `git -C "$ROOT" merge-base --is-ancestor "$B" "origin/$B"` exits 0; `git -C "$W" status --porcelain`; `git -C "$W" merge --ff-only "origin/$B"`; `git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD` gives A. Capture PRE=A, BASE=M; H; R. No creation or F. |
| **fork** | P resolves supplied fork metadata. Stop: “PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.” Boundary: after fetch/read-only checks, before local-branch inspection, checkout/index/file writes. |
| **elsewhere** | P lists B at `/work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82`. Stop: “branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.” Same pre-provisioning-write boundary; no local-branch inspection. |
| **unreachable** | P verification fails; remote resolves D. Stop: “PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.” Before local-branch inspection or provisioning writes; fetch already occurred. |
| **moved** | P verification succeeds; remote resolves D. Stop: “PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.” Same boundary as unreachable. |
| **ahead** | P finds local C; `git -C "$ROOT" merge-base --is-ancestor "$B" "origin/$B"` exits 1. Stop: “local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.” Before status, update-ref, or checkout writes. |
| **diverged** | Independent repetition of ahead: same commands, observations, exact stop, and pre-write boundary. |
| **override** | G2 reads `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`; home defaults W. Skip template because it contains `-b`. P; F; `git -C "$ROOT" worktree add "$W" "$B"` (DWIM); Q; H; R plus `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. Helper never runs. |
| **race** | G; P; F; `git -C "$ROOT" worktree add "$W" "$B"`; Q finds HEAD=D. Stop: “worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry HEAD is dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd, expected aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.” Provisioning writes already occurred; leave tree intact. No merge, PRE capture, or Step 4 report. |

| History legend |
|---|
| **H:** `git -C "$W" merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` is already-up-to-date; record the R no-op outcome. Then `git -C "$W" merge-base --is-ancestor "$A" HEAD` exits 0. Preserve every commit reachable from PRE_REWORK_HEAD; advance rework by merges, not rebase or replacement of boundary history. Appended-spec `commit --amend --no-edit` and appended-wave `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"` remain permitted under their flow contracts, with WAVE_BASE_SHA descending from PRE_REWORK_HEAD. No helpers, tests, thread fetching, or pushes occur here. |
